title: Support Windows
lead:
Umbrella slice. The work runs in four child slices, s22 to s25. s13 closes when
they are done and a real Windows render has been checked. Decisions made on
2026-10-20:

- Windows directories: config in `%APPDATA%\quire`, cache in
  `%LOCALAPPDATA%\quire\cache`, and launchers in
  `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\quire`. `XDG_*` variables still win when set.
- Launchers are `.cmd` files.
- WeasyPrint stays a pip install in `.venv`, with the GTK and Pango runtime
  installed separately.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Quire runs only on macOS and Linux today. It assumes the `.venv/bin` layout,
`/bin/sh` launchers, `~/.config` and `~/.cache`, the locale encoding for
subprocess output, and Homebrew library paths. Windows users
cannot install or run it.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
The children own the files: s22 the render path (quire.py, quire_common.py, and
the encoding in quire_math.py and quire_mermaid.py), s23 install.py, s24 the
optional renderers (install.py npm calls, the .mjs workers), and s25 CI, test
portability and docs. s13 itself changes no files.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
None of its own; each child carries its tests. Acceptance for s13 is a manual
check on a Windows host: `py install.py`, then `quire` renders a sample
Markdown file to PDF and HTML with non-ASCII text. A registered profile's
`<name>-pdf.cmd` launcher also works.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
Run s22, then s23. s24 and s25 can then run in parallel, because their files
are disjoint apart from README.md, which is resolved when landing. Platform
checks use `os.name == "nt"` and are patched in tests. POSIX behavior and the
CLI selection order do not change.

Out of scope:

- WeasyPrint's standalone executable
- a pip or pipx package, or any other packaging change
- PowerShell launchers
- WSL, which already works as Linux

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
Every child is done. The windows-latest CI job is green. The manual Windows
render above passes, or is reported as unverified with what is missing.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Do not commit; orchestrator handles it.
